exposure: iron therapy: successfully treated (Hgb≥11 g/dL), unsuccessfully treated ('refractory;' Hgb<11 g/dL), untreated
cohort: 20,690 pregnant women with adequate prenatal care from 2 delivery hospitals between 2011-2019
finding: Successful treatment of anemia with oral iron therapy was associated with a reduction in the odds of preterm birth and preeclampsia.
